Definition: to pace, i.e. step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl
BiblicalUsage: tsâʻad describes to pace, i.e. step regularly. It appears 8 times in Scripture, including Genesis 49:22 and 2 Samuel 6:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâʻad belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
